restatements.text: Prohibits physicians from performing abortions after 15 weeks of gestation, except to save the pregnant woman's life or prevent serious and irreversible physical impairment of a major bodily function.

findings.quote: No physician may perform an abortion after 15 weeks of gestation, except when necessary to prevent the death of the pregnant woman or serious risk of substantial and irreversible physical impairment of a major bodily function.
findings.mechanism: Establishes a 15-week gestational limit on abortion, replacing the viability standard.

findings.quote: No physician may perform an abortion after 15 weeks of gestation, except when necessary to prevent the death of the pregnant woman or serious risk of substantial and irreversible physical impairment of a major bodily function.
findings.mechanism: Restricts legal access to abortion by imposing a 15-week ban, removing access between 15 weeks and viability.

analysis.answer: Current law permits abortion until fetal viability. The proposed measure lowers the gestational limit, prohibiting abortion after 15 weeks of gestation, with narrow exceptions for the pregnant woman's life or to prevent serious physical impairment.

Women seeking abortions after 15 weeks of gestation would bear the burden of the restriction. Physicians would bear the burden of complying with the new limit and determining whether a patient's condition qualifies for the medical exception.

Women seeking an abortion after 15 weeks may be incentivized to travel to jurisdictions where the procedure remains legal, or they may carry the pregnancy to term. Physicians may alter their practice patterns out of caution to avoid violating the prohibition.

The state gains the authority to enforce restrictions on abortion earlier in pregnancy. Physicians gain the responsibility and discretion to interpret when a condition constitutes a 'serious risk of substantial and irreversible physical impairment.'

flags.quote: serious risk of substantial and irreversible physical impairment of a major bodily function
flags.note: The text relies on this phrase to define the medical exception without enumerating specific conditions, leaving it to case-by-case medical interpretation under the threat of violating the law.

items.text: Legal protection for prenatal life starting at 15 weeks of gestation.
Legal access to abortion between 15 weeks of gestation and fetal viability.
Legal access to abortion at any point up to fetal viability.
A ban on abortion after 15 weeks of gestation.
